a_before_b.rationale: Manual data inspection focuses on assessing annotation trustworthiness of existing data, while annotating evaluation data requires curating examples and applying scoring rubrics; one can design an evaluation dataset using production data and rubrics without first manually inspecting annotated data for trustworthiness.

b_before_a.rationale: Annotating evaluation data involves creating labeled examples with rubrics, whereas manual data inspection involves sampling and fact-checking already-annotated data; creating an evaluation set is not required before one can inspect and verify existing annotations.
